title: Current Evidence Claim Extraction
purpose: Convert W8A structurally validated sources into source-bounded minimal claim candidates with explicit locators and lineage, without admitting them as current evidence.
validationRules: sourceId must resolve to a W8A structurally validated source.
Claim dossierId must equal the source dossierId.
Claim laneId must be one of the source targetLanes.
Claim text must be a bounded factual proposition and may not be empty.
Every claim requires a source locator that can be used to find the supporting material again.
DIRECT and PARTIAL are the only allowed support levels; PARTIAL remains eligible for review but is not treated as complete support.
Claim type is only a candidate classification until Current Web Authority admission.
One source may support multiple claims and lanes, but each claimCandidateId must be unique.
Conflict groups may link contradictory or materially different claims without resolving them by source count.
Claim extraction does not infer runtime grammar, reality domain, Phase, current position, threshold crossing or future reachability.
Provider-derived claims may use API_RESPONSE_FIELD or PROVIDER_SERIES_WINDOW locators, but the referenced provider snapshot must preserve responseDigest and field/window lineage.
